items.title: Larry Gold interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 18, 2025
items.q: do you know the name of a bass player named Anthony Jackson?

ctx.x: Yeah she played the first one.

Well she should do a little more research. Because the first one there's one where they say the legato goes all the way through the whole measure. And then there's one where they say the legato goes halfway. So you can actually play it [scats] so you can breathe within that context. So like I said there are all different ways of stroking the kitty. You know? But I admire that. I remember — do you know the name of a bass player named Anthony Jackson?
